scope: Two ordinary offline survival protocol players per loopback platform; three normal starts of the same world. Seed uses player packets; verify and empty only observe existing furniture before actual player recovery. Official headless resource codecs, without GPU rendering or account authentication.
fixes: Absent initial save keys no longer freeze new pressing tubs, barrels or lottery machines; malformed existing tags still freeze operations and are preserved.
Late shaker item restoration prepares serialization before applying carried contents and synchronizes the future source item.

Six series furniture tickers resolve the current CraftEngine controller by metadata entity and matching furniture UUID, preserving the same-type occurrence ordinal across absolute behavior slots without an old-controller fallback.
Restart runner requires explicit phase reports, normal shutdowns, an immutable seed checkpoint and identical runtime JAR/resource and scenario-code hashes.
The repeated pressing-tub return explicitly reselects and reads back an empty hand after the first return fills the original selected slot; exact holdings reject duplicate output.

Original-scenario and restart sofa/Doll recovery share a network-position pickup helper with a five-second walking bound and a moving target; disappearance or replacement of that exact network entity stops walking only, after which authoritative participant inventories must still prove pickup. Restart observes both participants through persistinspect, records the actual owner, and rejects duplicate combined counts or changed source PDC.

The original sofa/Doll replay temporarily moves the peer away through a bounded clear lane only after the interaction-denial assertions, requires the acting player to own the recovered item, and returns the peer in a finally block.

A read-only FurnitureInteractEvent MONITOR counter acknowledges each single network furniture use, including cancellation and no-op cases; bounded polling requires a receipt increment plus exact expected state, preserves invariants on each observation, and never resends the action.
Each single Doll-axis menu click waits first for the exact progressively committed nine-axis pose and then for a newly opened menu window before the next click.

Concurrent tulip harvest reads both baselines before two single old-target packets, requires at least one receipt with exact empty state and one drop, and permits a missing second receipt only when the hitbox changed; B then performs a separately acknowledged fresh-hitbox empty use without another drop.

The tulip-board scenario settles and accounts for its sole returned flower through normal network inventory and pickup actions before any subsequent fixture setup. It records the actual owner and storage slot plus whether a full-storage stack moved to offhand, preserves unrelated inventory components, and leaves the following sofa whole-inventory invariant strict.
limitations: Only the red/left sofa, doll_0 nine-axis pose and unprocessed marked pressing-tub ingredient have this three-phase player restart evidence.
Barrel, bottle, shaker and lottery persistence or ticker dispatch have unit regressions; this run does not prove their full player flows.
No GPU visuals, audio, authenticated account, third-party protection, independent chunk unload, hot reload, cross-region or density/performance acceptance.

Concurrent tulip attemptedPlayers records the two sent requests; acknowledged lists only observed FurnitureInteractEvents. A request to the retired hitbox may not reach a controller, so two controller deliveries are not claimed.

Tulip cleanup proves the returned flower by server storage-inventory differences and validates transfer cursor transitions with server snapshots. The reserved offhand stack is observed through ordinary client inventory packets; the probe does not expose a server-side offhand snapshot.

CraftEngine startup watchdog causes remain open, including the historical native recipe-registration sample and Folia2 at 6.3533891 seconds while shaded ByteBuddy instrumentation entered FastNMSImpl.createSmithingTrimRecipe; later clean starts do not erase these failures.
Upstream release-license blockers and remaining feature parity gaps remain open; the full series is not accepted.
